items.title: Man pleads guilty to federal hate crimes in deadly firebomb attack on Colorado demonstrators
items.brief: An Egyptian man faces an additional life sentence after pleading guilty Thursday to federal hate crime and other charges for a deadly firebombing attack on demonstrators in Boulder, Colorado, last year.

items.title: Russia strikes Dnipro train station in central Ukraine, killing 14
items.brief: A Russian drone struck the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro as people waited to board a train on Thursday morning, killing 14 people.

items.title: FDA plans to update infant formula nutrition requirements for first time in decades
items.brief: The US Food and Drug Administration is proposing changes to nutrient requirements for infant formula.

items.title: Machado pushes for new elections in first news conference since returning to Venezuela
items.brief: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado said she returned to the country from exile this past week to mobilize society as she pushes for new elections next year.

items.title: The range of outcomes in the 2026 battle for the Senate is enormous
items.brief: Imagine when the dust settles on the 2026 midterm elections that Democrats haven’t gained a single Senate seat and are stuck at 47.

items.title: What caused the deadly train crash in Spain? What we know so far
items.brief: Spain has begun three days of national mourning after 69 people were killed and over 100 injured in a high-speed train collision, the third deadly incident this year on the country’s rail network.
